NO ORDERING CLOSES THIS. A file cannot contain a hash of itself, and a file the harness rewrites at every state transition cannot be a byte-bound archival artifact. The defect is general: any batch declaring dispatch_queue.json as an artifact and archiving content_first hits it.

It is therefore quoted VERBATIM inside CPC-1 above, in this bound receipt, together with its commit 3813b4df1.
